subject: Judge: review API/OpenRouter in-process backend
description: Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge review mode) of the API-backend attempt. get_attempt_diff, then rubric: (1) callApi does an in-process HTTPS call (NO child_process spawn — verify no spawn/exec in the api path; this is the AV-clean requirement); (2) runJudgeLoop returns the SAME verdict shape the spawn judge produces so headless-drain uses it interchangeably; (3) headless-drain's judge drain calls runJudgeLoop for api-kind (replacing /16's api_backend_not_implemented skip), agentic-cli spawn path unchanged; (4) API key via overlay.config or OPENROUTER_API_KEY, isAuthed gates correctly, hard-block still applies when unauthed; (5) backoff/cap/flag-off preserved; tests mock HTTP + assert no-spawn; scope excludes dashboard + Codex/Cursor. Under the feature, APPROVE → merge_attempt (attempt→feature, auto-abort on conflict); KICK BACK → set_status failed + record_decision wired to the impl. NEVER force-merge.

summary: APPROVED + merged impl /18 (cf7ea56) into orch/feature/pluggable-backend (feature HEAD now 542ddd4). Load-bearing check passed: api path (callApi + runJudgeLoop + helpers) is pure Node https/http — the only spawnSync is in resolveClaudeBin on the agentic-cli path, unreachable from api; tripwire genuinely covers both seams (7-method child_process patch + assert in finally; headless-drain asserts spawn calls===0 through the real drain path). 88/88 tests pass, node --check clean on all 4 files, consumer claude-cli.js re-exports resolve. Rubric all-PASS: correctness, interchangeable drain-result shape, drain wiring (api_backend_not_implemented removed, kind:'api'→in-process wrapped try/catch, governor/caps/ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS-OFF preserved), auth hard-block, scope clean. Did not kick back for the environmental pre-existing full-suite failures per handoff.
